name: coordrippr
//version: Bumping by 0.1 goes to 0.x.0 (minor +1, patch reset to 0); bumping by 0.0.1 goes to 0.0.x (patch +1).
description: Extract coordinate data from PDFs into clean CSV
author: Caleb Hendren <calebahendren@gmail.com>
//scripts: Run `npm install` first — needs network to download Electron and pdfjs-dist. start: launch the app. test: node --test (pure-module tests need nothing extra; pdf-extract.test.js also needs pdfjs-dist installed). web: build the browser version into dist-web/. dist: package installers.

linux.description: GUI tool that scans PDFs (including two-column journal articles) for latitude/longitude coordinates in DD or DMS form, highlights them on the page, and exports a cleaned CSV.

//build: OCR (src/ocrengine.js) loads tesseract.js/dist, the three *-lstm.wasm.js builds of tesseract.js-core (each embeds its .wasm) and eng 4.0.0_best_int from node_modules/ by URL. The core is copied by an explicit file set because electron-builder otherwise nests it under tesseract.js/node_modules/; the patterns keep the rest of those packages (~45 MB) out of the installer.
